name: equatorial Pacific upper-ocean heat content anomaly, 0-300 m

issuer.name: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) Climate Prediction Center (CPC)

notes: Received in the 2026-09-07 expansion proposal as a 'subsurface precursor' for nearTerm. Ruled: current horizon, observation only, or not at all.

Lead to verify, not a fact: CPC's ENSO monitoring products include an equatorial upper-ocean heat content anomaly series; PSL also serves related series. Find the file from the CPC ENSO monitoring index page and record the receipt; do not construct a URL.

The index is widely described as leading SST. That is why the proposed_text must not say so. If the only issuer sentence available frames it as an outlook, claim.kind becomes issuer-outlook and the DR default is option (b): carry the data, show nothing.
Every gate is false until a session fills the receipt above it. The file is complete as a template when all five are true and status is decided.
